resources.title: Immortal Guide to Saryn Prime - Endgame Steel Path
resources.creator: XH
resources.noteEs: Build de Saryn Prime para Steel Path enfocada en nuke de área y supervivencia. Saryn es uno de los frames de clear de hordas más usados; buena base para quien quiere borrar mapas en endgame.
resources.noteEn: Saryn Prime build for Steel Path focused on AoE nuke and survivability. Saryn is one of the most-used horde-clear frames; a solid base for clearing maps in endgame.

resources.title: WISP PRIME BUILD | LEVEL 9999 Void Cascade Steel Path DESTROYER!
resources.creator: Hunkpain Gaming
resources.noteEs: Build híbrida de soporte y DPS para Wisp Prime apuntada a Steel Path de nivel extremo. Cubre un arquetipo distinto al de Saryn — buff de squad más daño sostenido — para contenido de level cap.
resources.noteEn: Support/DPS hybrid build for Wisp Prime aimed at extreme-level Steel Path. It covers a different archetype than Saryn — squad buffing plus sustained damage — for level-cap content.

resources.title: Warframe NERFED Dante... Now he's BETTER than EVER!
resources.creator: MHBlacky
resources.noteEs: Build de Dante post-nerf con foco en overguard y nuke de slash. Relevante porque parte del rebalance y muestra el setup óptimo actual de un frame que sigue siendo top tier.
resources.noteEn: Post-nerf Dante build focused on overguard and slash nuke. Relevant because it addresses the rebalance and shows the current optimal setup of a frame that remains top tier.

resources.title: The UNKILLABLE Revenant Prime! | Steel Path Tank Build | WARFRAME 2025
resources.creator: O Dawg
resources.noteEs: Build tank de Revenant Prime para Steel Path apoyada en su Mesmer Skin (invulnerabilidad). Es el frame de 'no me puedo morir' por excelencia — ideal para jugadores que quieren sobrevivir contenido alto sin pensar mucho en defensas.
resources.noteEn: Revenant Prime tank build for Steel Path leaning on his Mesmer Skin (invincibility). It's the quintessential 'I can't die' frame — ideal for players who want to survive high content without overthinking defenses.

resources.title: Ultimate Octavia Prime Build for Level Cap 9999 Steel Path [Warframe]
resources.creator: Hunkpain Gaming
resources.noteEs: Build de Octavia Prime para level cap (Mallet/Resonator) en Steel Path. Cubre el arquetipo de nuke escalable más fuerte del juego — daño que crece con el nivel enemigo — distinto a los otros frames de la lista.
resources.noteEn: Octavia Prime level-cap build (Mallet/Resonator) for Steel Path. It covers the strongest scaling-nuke archetype in the game — damage that grows with enemy level — distinct from the other frames in this list.
